extraction.name: EuroSAT
extraction.description: A novel dataset based on Sentinel-2 satellite images covering 13 spectral bands and consisting out of 10 classes with in total 27,000 labeled and geo-referenced images.
extraction.license: Openly and freely accessible provided in the Earth observation program Copernicus; can be used for any application (commercial or non-commercial use).
extraction.creator: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth
extraction.publisher: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence (DFKI), TU Kaiserslautern
extraction.citeAs: Patrick Helber, Benjamin Bischke, Andreas Dengel, Damian Borth. Introducing EuroSAT: A Novel Dataset and Deep Learning Benchmark for Land Use and Land Cover Classification In Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS), 2018 IEEE International. IEEE, 2018.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: We gathered satellite images of European cities distributed in over 34 countries. Based on the obtained satellite images, we created a dataset of 27,000 georeferenced and labeled image patches.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionMissingData: We manually checked all 27,000 images multiple times and corrected the ground truth by sorting out mislabeled images as well as images full of snow or ice or dead pixels.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Sentinel-2 satellite images downloaded via Amazon S3
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: Images recorded all over the year
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Bands with a lower spatial resolution have been upsampled to 10 meters per pixel using cubic-spline interpolation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Patches measure 64x64 pixels. We manually checked all 27,000 images multiple times and corrected the ground truth by sorting out mislabeled images as well as images full of snow or ice. The proposed dataset has not received atmospheric correction.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: We manually checked all 27,000 images multiple times and corrected the ground truth by sorting out mislabeled images as well as images full of snow or ice. The composition of the individual classes and their relationships are specified in the mapping guide of the European Urban Atlas.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Applications in the domains of agriculture, disaster recovery, climate change, urban development, or environmental monitoring. Detection of deforested land is of particular interest (e.g., to notice illegal clearing of forests).
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The distribution is influenced by the number of represented cities per country in the European Urban Atlas. The classes most common to each other are the two presented agricultural classes and the two classes representing residential and industrial buildings.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The proposed dataset has not received atmospheric correction, which can result in images with a color cast. The classifier sometimes confuses the agricultural land classes as well as the classes highway and river. Uses a 10 times lower spatial resolution than the benchmark dataset closest to our research.
